name: installed-pip-probe
args: import json,pip,site,sys;from pathlib import Path;assert pip.__version__=='26.2.1';assert sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix and site.ENABLE_USER_SITE is False;assert Path(pip.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve());print(json.dumps({'version':pip.__version__,'module':pip.__file__,'prefix':sys.prefix,'base_prefix':sys.base_prefix,'user_site':site.ENABLE_USER_SITE}))
